#
 Spiritual
 Translation


**
¶2:** When
 the Divine
 Human first
 descended
 into combat against the hells, He
 clothed Himself in the outer
most expression of divine love. With
 that love
 He collapsed
 the swelling pride of
 evil;
 He laid
 bare its
 persu
asive
 falsities
 and
 reduced
 its empty
 self
-exaltation to
 nothing.

**¶3:**
 Now
, divine
 love alone
 would
 have
 been sufficient against
 them
. Yet
 because
 love
 in
 its outermost form was
 weakened when
 it entered directly
 into the
 assault
 of the
 hells, the
 Divine
 provided
 four additional degrees
 of truth to support it: the
 truth
 of spiritual thought, the truth of natural
 understanding
, the truth of intellectual clarity, and
 the truth of in
most
 rational life. And
 why
 were
 these four
 given?
 They
 were given so
 that they
 would
 serve
 and
 protect divine
 love on
 every
 side
 —
 so
 that fals
ity would
 not penetrate through love and
 corrupt
 it,
 and so
 that the
 poison
 and
 
enmity of evil would not s
ever love
 from its source
.

**¶4:** Divine
 love in its outermost expression received
 the
 full
 assault and
 was
 wounded.
 Yet
 still
, all
 the powers of hell
 were
 held
 at
 bay because
 of it. Of
 necessity
, the
 tru
ths at every level
 —
 love
's
 companion
 fac
ulties —
 also
 received the
 wound of
 that
 assault
.
 Fals
ity from
 evil
 became
 min
gled with them. All
 except
 the inmost rational life
.
 Evil
 could not m
ingle with it
, nor could the consuming
 fire of self
-love penetrate it.

**
¶5:** Nevertheless
, even that
 faculty
 which
 remained behind without wound
 — the
 inmost rational life
 — div
ested itself of its own
 protective truth and communicated its
 power to its
 four wounded
 companions
,
 so that by
 the
 truth
 of that unw
ounded rational
 life they would
 be
 strengthened,
 and sustained
, and end
ure:
 namely
, love
 and its
 three fellow
 tru
ths. And it became for
 them the
 hidden
 well
spring of life itself
.
